precedingBindings.speaker: Stallholder
precedingBindings.quote: Funny thing to sell,
precedingBindings.text: Funny thing to sell,

precedingBindings.speaker: Stallholder
precedingBindings.quote: Yesterday.
precedingBindings.text: Yesterday.

precedingBindings.speaker: Stallholder
precedingBindings.quote: A regular came in last winter,
precedingBindings.text: A regular came in last winter,

precedingBindings.speaker: Stallholder
precedingBindings.quote: He'd sold an argument with his wife to make the rent. Remembered getting paid. Didn't remember what he needed to apologize for. Asked me to write it down.
precedingBindings.text: He'd sold an argument with his wife to make the rent. Remembered getting paid. Didn't remember what he needed to apologize for. Asked me to write it down.

precedingBindings.speaker: Stallholder
precedingBindings.quote: I sell dinner. But if someone hires you to carry an hour, ask whose it was before you ask what it pays.
precedingBindings.text: I sell dinner. But if someone hires you to carry an hour, ask whose it was before you ask what it pays.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact. Fifty now, two hundred on delivery. Her bodyguard is Kerr. He is paid to stop you.
precedingBindings.text: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact. Fifty now, two hundred on delivery. Her bodyguard is Kerr. He is paid to stop you.
precedingBindings.text: Fifty now, two hundred on delivery. Her bodyguard is Kerr. He is paid to stop you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Fifty now. Two hundred when the shard is in my hand and not wandering around in your bloodstream. Kerr is her shadow. Kerr is why the number is not prettier.
precedingBindings.text: Fifty now. Two hundred when the shard is in my hand and not wandering around in your bloodstream. Kerr is her shadow. Kerr is why the number is not prettier.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Ninety. I will not go higher unless you are secretly three people. Two hundred on delivery, and if you die I am billing the corpse for my time.
precedingBindings.text: Ninety. I will not go higher unless you are secretly three people. Two hundred on delivery, and if you die I am billing the corpse for my time.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Ninety now. Two hundred for the intact shard. Before dawn. Those are the terms.
precedingBindings.text: Ninety now. Two hundred for the intact shard. Before dawn. Those are the terms.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: The front desk will ask for one,
precedingBindings.text: The front desk will ask for one,

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: The other doors ask different questions.
precedingBindings.text: The other doors ask different questions.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Three ways in. The front sells forgiveness to anyone with an appointment. The hatch behind the incinerator is for people who still sweat. The choir door runs on an old Helion pad. I would not kiss it.
precedingBindings.text: Three ways in. The front sells forgiveness to anyone with an appointment. The hatch behind the incinerator is for people who still sweat. The choir door runs on an old Helion pad. I would not kiss it.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You are not on the penitent list. Dawn puts Mara Voss in that chair so Helion can edit a crime out of her. The next sentence should be one you can survive.
precedingBindings.text: You are not on the penitent list. Dawn puts Mara Voss in that chair so Helion can edit a crime out of her. The next sentence should be one you can survive.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Copy it. Then we both leave holding a fire. Do not get clever and die.
precedingBindings.text: Copy it. Then we both leave holding a fire. Do not get clever and die.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: I signed the coolant dump. Ward Nine. Three hundred on the night shift. I want that sentence to stay in my mouth.
precedingBindings.text: I signed the coolant dump. Ward Nine. Three hundred on the night shift. I want that sentence to stay in my mouth.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: Helion told me the dump was a flush, not a kill. I signed because the night shift was already in the building and I thought the tower would move them. They did not move them.
precedingBindings.text: Helion told me the dump was a flush, not a kill. I signed because the night shift was already in the building and I thought the tower would move them. They did not move them.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: People will repeat the sentence before they inspect the source. You can say what the receipt contains and what still needs checking. Or you can name the tower now and accept what happens when it challenges your proof.
precedingBindings.text: People will repeat the sentence before they inspect the source. You can say what the receipt contains and what still needs checking. Or you can name the tower now and accept what happens when it challenges your proof.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: Put it down.
precedingBindings.text: Put it down.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: That glass is Mara's hour. Helion pays me so the Ward Nine memo stays in her head, not in your pocket.
precedingBindings.text: That glass is Mara's hour. Helion pays me so the Ward Nine memo stays in her head, not in your pocket.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: It goes to a clinic,
precedingBindings.text: It goes to a clinic,

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Get it there. Asa will leave you a clearance for one passenger.
precedingBindings.text: Get it there. Asa will leave you a clearance for one passenger.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: Diagnostic cartridge. Clinic stock. My manifest can't cross this gate.
precedingBindings.text: Diagnostic cartridge. Clinic stock. My manifest can't cross this gate.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: Keep it cold. Get a receipt. No patient names. If the service route stays private, I can spare one passenger clearance. Register the handover and that route retires.
precedingBindings.text: Keep it cold. Get a receipt. No patient names. If the service route stays private, I can spare one passenger clearance. Register the handover and that route retires.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: One crossing. Tell me when the week is over what it was for.
precedingBindings.text: One crossing. Tell me when the week is over what it was for.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: We kept the name. Burning the badge was a hobby.
precedingBindings.text: We kept the name. Burning the badge was a hobby.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ren
precedingBindings.quote: Junie Calder worked beside Ivo Pell,
precedingBindings.text: Junie Calder worked beside Ivo Pell,

precedingBindings.speaker: Ren
precedingBindings.quote: Say her if you get to the wall. She was my family before she was your evidence.
precedingBindings.text: Say her if you get to the wall. She was my family before she was your evidence.

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: Your export records a cancellation. My ledger can show whether it reached the shift. Compare them. I have to work here tomorrow.
precedingBindings.text: Your export records a cancellation. My ledger can show whether it reached the shift. Compare them. I have to work here tomorrow.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: If you allege an instruction, identify its issuer. We will challenge anything less.
precedingBindings.text: If you allege an instruction, identify its issuer. We will challenge anything less.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: They need to know where the clinic is,
precedingBindings.text: They need to know where the clinic is,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: They do not need to tell every landlord where they sleep. Dispatch wants a route it can verify. I need a notice people can actually use.
precedingBindings.text: They do not need to tell every landlord where they sleep. Dispatch wants a route it can verify. I need a notice people can actually use.

precedingBindings.speaker: Dispatcher
precedingBindings.quote: I can take that split if you carry the clinic's return bundle to this desk.
precedingBindings.text: I can take that split if you carry the clinic's return bundle to this desk.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Come back when the window has passed. A plan deserves an answer, even if it was a good plan.
precedingBindings.text: Come back when the window has passed. A plan deserves an answer, even if it was a good plan.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: What do we put beside it?
precedingBindings.text: What do we put beside it?

precedingBindings.speaker: Mechanic
precedingBindings.quote: The file says evacuation was canceled. I still need to know who sent it. Don't rub out the question mark because the wall is waiting.
precedingBindings.text: The file says evacuation was canceled. I still need to know who sent it. Don't rub out the question mark because the wall is waiting.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: Ivo stays legible,
precedingBindings.text: Ivo stays legible,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: The third row needs your eye, or help from the wards. You can try. You can also tell me why you came.
precedingBindings.text: The third row needs your eye, or help from the wards. You can try. You can also tell me why you came.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: The parcel got there, privately. One crossing was what I owed you.
precedingBindings.text: The parcel got there, privately. One crossing was what I owed you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: A parcel is somebody's morning,
precedingBindings.text: A parcel is somebody's morning,

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: What were you trying to carry for yourself?
precedingBindings.text: What were you trying to carry for yourself?

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: Keep your name,
precedingBindings.text: Keep your name,

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: And remember that the people receiving your work have names too.
precedingBindings.text: And remember that the people receiving your work have names too.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: If you know any of them,
precedingBindings.text: If you know any of them,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: say them. If you sold them, you can still say them. The wall does not check your receipt.
precedingBindings.text: say them. If you sold them, you can still say them. The wall does not check your receipt.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: The names can be spoken either way. This is a different promise: an account someone can question after you leave.
precedingBindings.text: The names can be spoken either way. This is a different promise: an account someone can question after you leave.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: A maintenance signature isn't an issuing key. A witness isn't a server. What exactly are you asking people to believe?
precedingBindings.text: A maintenance signature isn't an issuing key. A witness isn't a server. What exactly are you asking people to believe?

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: Correct it here. A correction belongs beside what people already heard.
precedingBindings.text: Correct it here. A correction belongs beside what people already heard.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: We still have the names.
precedingBindings.text: We still have the names.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: I won't call you back,
precedingBindings.text: I won't call you back,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: I have the pencil. The rain can wait with me.
precedingBindings.text: I have the pencil. The rain can wait with me.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: No speeches. Put your shoulder here. Someone has to sleep upstairs tonight.
precedingBindings.text: No speeches. Put your shoulder here. Someone has to sleep upstairs tonight.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: Six households upstairs. One valve downstairs. We stop the leak or move everyone to the hall.
precedingBindings.text: Six households upstairs. One valve downstairs. We stop the leak or move everyone to the hall.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ren
precedingBindings.quote: We can walk. My father needs the ramp, not the stairs.
precedingBindings.text: We can walk. My father needs the ramp, not the stairs.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ren
precedingBindings.quote: We’re here,
precedingBindings.text: We’re here,

precedingBindings.speaker: Ren
precedingBindings.quote: It’s loud. It’s still somewhere.
precedingBindings.text: It’s loud. It’s still somewhere.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: Come back when it’s daylight. A place to sleep is the start of a night, not the whole of it.
precedingBindings.text: Come back when it’s daylight. A place to sleep is the start of a night, not the whole of it.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ren
precedingBindings.quote: Dad reached the ramp. We slept, but the hall lights stayed on.
precedingBindings.text: Dad reached the ramp. We slept, but the hall lights stayed on.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: The clothes are what they have left. Help me get them clean?
precedingBindings.text: The clothes are what they have left. Help me get them clean?

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Then do not spend your whole advance on my pass,
precedingBindings.text: Then do not spend your whole advance on my pass,

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: There are other doors.
precedingBindings.text: There are other doors.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: Ask me while I'm still here. They bought the hour so I wouldn't have to answer twice.
precedingBindings.text: Ask me while I'm still here. They bought the hour so I wouldn't have to answer twice.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: A green light on the dispatch channel. It meant the evacuation crew had been assigned. I let it mean they'd finished.
precedingBindings.text: A green light on the dispatch channel. It meant the evacuation crew had been assigned. I let it mean they'd finished.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: I could have waited for the exit count. Waiting would have put my name on the delay. I told myself a crew assignment was enough.
precedingBindings.text: I could have waited for the exit count. Waiting would have put my name on the delay. I told myself a crew assignment was enough.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: Dispatch spoke through a shift relay. No face. I knew the channel had authority to assign crews; I didn't know who was on it.
precedingBindings.text: Dispatch spoke through a shift relay. No face. I knew the channel had authority to assign crews; I didn't know who was on it.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: Don't put a person in that blank because I was too willing to leave it blank myself.
precedingBindings.text: Don't put a person in that blank because I was too willing to leave it blank myself.

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: I need the old maintenance key out of this terminal,
precedingBindings.text: I need the old maintenance key out of this terminal,

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: They still bill my shifts against it. Get it out clean and take the receiver.
precedingBindings.text: They still bill my shifts against it. Get it out clean and take the receiver.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You can tell me what the hour was worth,
precedingBindings.text: You can tell me what the hour was worth,

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: or you can walk past and let the canal be the argument.
precedingBindings.text: or you can walk past and let the canal be the argument.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: Week's up,
precedingBindings.text: Week's up,

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: Helion paid me to know the weight of that glass. You are the part of the weight I can still invoice.
precedingBindings.text: Helion paid me to know the weight of that glass. You are the part of the weight I can still invoice.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Help the room before you make it a sentence,
precedingBindings.text: Help the room before you make it a sentence,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: If the spare won't start, we move the medicines.
precedingBindings.text: If the spare won't start, we move the medicines.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: The knee won't hold a wheel. The door I can do.
precedingBindings.text: The knee won't hold a wheel. The door I can do.

precedingBindings.speaker: Dispatcher
precedingBindings.quote: I won't promise the third. Carry it to the later desk yourself, fund another carrier, or change the split.
precedingBindings.text: I won't promise the third. Carry it to the later desk yourself, fund another carrier, or change the split.

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: This tells us where to look. It isn't the record. My countersignature isn't the command's issuing key either.
precedingBindings.text: This tells us where to look. It isn't the record. My countersignature isn't the command's issuing key either.

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: Keep the original with Sera,
precedingBindings.text: Keep the original with Sera,

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: Ask before you put my name on a public copy.
precedingBindings.text: Ask before you put my name on a public copy.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Two reached somebody. The rest have no reply yet. An acknowledgement does not tell me they came to clinic.
precedingBindings.text: Two reached somebody. The rest have no reply yet. An acknowledgement does not tell me they came to clinic.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You asked me to keep the records separate,
precedingBindings.text: You asked me to keep the records separate,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Keep the reply separate too.
precedingBindings.text: Keep the reply separate too.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: That split needed the extra carrier you funded. Keep the work beside the plan.
precedingBindings.text: That split needed the extra carrier you funded. Keep the work beside the plan.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You told me the names. This time I kept a door open. That doesn't settle the rest of my week.
precedingBindings.text: You told me the names. This time I kept a door open. That doesn't settle the rest of my week.

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: Keep the original available,
precedingBindings.text: Keep the original available,

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: Let them question the record without making my shifts the story.
precedingBindings.text: Let them question the record without making my shifts the story.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mechanic
precedingBindings.quote: Now I can ask two questions instead of repeating one accusation.
precedingBindings.text: Now I can ask two questions instead of repeating one accusation.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: That split needed your extra later trip. Keep the work beside the plan.
precedingBindings.text: That split needed your extra later trip. Keep the work beside the plan.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Carrying six papers isn't six places in the room. The last two would arrive to a full window.
precedingBindings.text: Carrying six papers isn't six places in the room. The last two would arrive to a full window.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: No. Give them my desk, not somebody else's front door.
precedingBindings.text: No. Give them my desk, not somebody else's front door.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: That split needed your clinic return bundle. Keep the work beside the plan.
precedingBindings.text: That split needed your clinic return bundle. Keep the work beside the plan.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Start by choosing how you get in,
precedingBindings.text: Start by choosing how you get in,

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: I can answer for what we saw. I can’t sign for the part we didn’t.
precedingBindings.text: I can answer for what we saw. I can’t sign for the part we didn’t.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: The parcel got there. The route is still exposed and retired.
precedingBindings.text: The parcel got there. The route is still exposed and retired.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: A way out still has somebody at the other end,
precedingBindings.text: A way out still has somebody at the other end,

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: Choose who you ask to hold the door.
precedingBindings.text: Choose who you ask to hold the door.

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: I know what a paid tomorrow means,
precedingBindings.text: I know what a paid tomorrow means,

precedingBindings.speaker: Asa
precedingBindings.quote: Just keep the receipt honest about whose morning it bought.
precedingBindings.text: Just keep the receipt honest about whose morning it bought.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You isolated it. The maintenance fault is on their log, even if your name isn't.
precedingBindings.text: You isolated it. The maintenance fault is on their log, even if your name isn't.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: I already decided you were a person.
precedingBindings.text: I already decided you were a person.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Ward Nine is still down there,
precedingBindings.text: Ward Nine is still down there,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: The shard is a week old, wherever it went. I called you back because memory gets thin if nobody walks it back to the wall. Come with me, or tell me you are done and mean it.
precedingBindings.text: The shard is a week old, wherever it went. I called you back because memory gets thin if nobody walks it back to the wall. Come with me, or tell me you are done and mean it.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: You promised a witness. I promised nothing to a transmitter. I need care, a room they don't own, and a say in which words leave it. Can you do those separately?
precedingBindings.text: You promised a witness. I promised nothing to a transmitter. I need care, a room they don't own, and a say in which words leave it. Can you do those separately?

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: Don't publish my address and call that courage,
precedingBindings.text: Don't publish my address and call that courage,

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: Give me somewhere they don't rent to me. Then I'll tell Sera what I saw.
precedingBindings.text: Give me somewhere they don't rent to me. Then I'll tell Sera what I saw.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: You got me here,
precedingBindings.text: You got me here,

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: Now I want to hear the words before anyone uses them. No address. No photograph. If I stop, you stop.
precedingBindings.text: Now I want to hear the words before anyone uses them. No address. No photograph. If I stop, you stop.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: That part stays,
precedingBindings.text: That part stays,

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: The address doesn't. If they ask where I am, tell them I am available through you.
precedingBindings.text: The address doesn't. If they ask where I am, tell them I am available through you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: They have my replacement at the canal depot. Unpowered, no miracle in it. I want the case, not a treatment report. Their free courier gate writes the recipient into the shift register. If you promise to keep my name out, don't save your fare by putting it in.
precedingBindings.text: They have my replacement at the canal depot. Unpowered, no miracle in it.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: They have my replacement at the canal depot. Unpowered, no miracle in it. I want the case, not a treatment report. Their free courier gate writes the recipient into the shift register. If you promise to keep my name out, don't save your fare by putting it in.
precedingBindings.text: I want the case, not a treatment report. Their free courier gate writes the recipient into the shift register. If you promise to keep my name out, don't save your fare by putting it in.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You brought the case. You also put my name in their register after promising not to. Those aren't the same line.
precedingBindings.text: You brought the case. You also put my name in their register after promising not to. Those aren't the same line.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: The room is mine to name. That matters more than what you called the job.
precedingBindings.text: The room is mine to name. That matters more than what you called the job.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: An empty address field. Keep it that way when you tell the story.
precedingBindings.text: An empty address field. Keep it that way when you tell the story.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You wrote my name after promising not to. Don't call this private.
precedingBindings.text: You wrote my name after promising not to. Don't call this private.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: The terms arrive with the case.
precedingBindings.text: The terms arrive with the case.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You can't unwrite the depot. You can stop asking me to pretend you kept the private part. Tell me what you'll put beside that promise.
precedingBindings.text: You can't unwrite the depot. You can stop asking me to pretend you kept the private part. Tell me what you'll put beside that promise.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: She agreed to record it. That wasn't permission for every public use.
precedingBindings.text: She agreed to record it. That wasn't permission for every public use.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: Use the words I approved. You can name me as the source through Sera. No address, no new story about how brave I was, and no sentence saying the room made me owe you this.
precedingBindings.text: Use the words I approved. You can name me as the source through Sera. No address, no new story about how brave I was, and no sentence saying the room made me owe you this.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: One at a time,
precedingBindings.text: One at a time,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: The wall has room for a voice. It has never had room for an excuse.
precedingBindings.text: The wall has room for a voice. It has never had room for an excuse.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: No recipient entry. That was the part I asked you to keep.
precedingBindings.text: No recipient entry. That was the part I asked you to keep.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You left them somewhere to send it back. Good. A private name shouldn't make a lost case somebody else's problem.
precedingBindings.text: You left them somewhere to send it back. Good. A private name shouldn't make a lost case somebody else's problem.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: No recipient entry,
precedingBindings.text: No recipient entry,

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr

precedingBindings.quote: Pass still scans,

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Then work.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Try not to bleed on the penitent tile. We just had it blessed.
precedingBindings.text: Try not to bleed on the penitent tile. We just had it blessed.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Keep the advance,
precedingBindings.text: Keep the advance,

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Lose my name for a while.
precedingBindings.text: Lose my name for a while.

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: No wage receipt today,
precedingBindings.text: No wage receipt today,

precedingBindings.speaker: Edda
precedingBindings.quote: Just what payroll did with the number.
precedingBindings.text: Just what payroll did with the number.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Fifty. You already asked. I already didn't. The rain is free if you want a longer conversation.
precedingBindings.text: Fifty. You already asked. I already didn't. The rain is free if you want a longer conversation.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Kerr likes liars. The chair room is up the stair. So is he, in a moment.
precedingBindings.text: Kerr likes liars. The chair room is up the stair. So is he, in a moment.

precedingBindings.speaker: Mara
precedingBindings.quote: That is mine. I signed it. Don't make the tower's next decision erase the one I made.
precedingBindings.text: That is mine. I signed it. Don't make the tower's next decision erase the one I made.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: Helion can pay forty for a week of quiet,
precedingBindings.text: Helion can pay forty for a week of quiet,

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: Or you can try to close this in the street, where we are already writing.
precedingBindings.text: Or you can try to close this in the street, where we are already writing.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: I did my job,
precedingBindings.text: I did my job,

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You did not do yours. The knee still wants a conversation, and I am the only one who will have it without a memo.
precedingBindings.text: You did not do yours. The knee still wants a conversation, and I am the only one who will have it without a memo.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You held it open with your hands. Maintenance will notice that.
precedingBindings.text: You held it open with your hands. Maintenance will notice that.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Break it after. I want to see the light go out.
precedingBindings.text: Break it after. I want to see the light go out.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You can still stand in the street,
precedingBindings.text: You can still stand in the street,

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: They will already be listening. Or you take what is left of the quiet money. It is not eighty. It is what they pay for a confession they already own.
precedingBindings.text: They will already be listening. Or you take what is left of the quiet money. It is not eighty. It is what they pay for a confession they already own.

precedingBindings.speaker: Masked attendant
precedingBindings.quote: This vein is hot,
precedingBindings.text: This vein is hot,

precedingBindings.speaker: Masked attendant
precedingBindings.quote: You are not on the hot list.
precedingBindings.text: You are not on the hot list.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: There is no departure on that plan. Don't give it an ending it hasn't earned.
precedingBindings.text: There is no departure on that plan. Don't give it an ending it hasn't earned.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You sold my week. Coming back to this desk doesn't unsell it.
precedingBindings.text: You sold my week. Coming back to this desk doesn't unsell it.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: There are two fires,
precedingBindings.text: There are two fires,

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: We bought one. We would like the other to stop being a rumor.
precedingBindings.text: We bought one. We would like the other to stop being a rumor.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: You sold us a damaged hour,
precedingBindings.text: You sold us a damaged hour,

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: We would like the name of whoever fried the rest.
precedingBindings.text: We would like the name of whoever fried the rest.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: Walk in blind, then. The chair does not care about your reasons, and I am done spending mine on you.
precedingBindings.text: Walk in blind, then. The chair does not care about your reasons, and I am done spending mine on you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: They kept the reason you walked in,
precedingBindings.text: They kept the reason you walked in,

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: I kept you. That was not the contract. The contract is the part where you tell me what the shard was worth, and then you pay me for the week I spent not letting the chair finish.
precedingBindings.text: I kept you. That was not the contract. The contract is the part where you tell me what the shard was worth, and then you pay me for the week I spent not letting the chair finish.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You sold the week after walking with me. Helping with this reply doesn't make that disappear. Leave future messages at the desk; don't speak as my partner.
precedingBindings.text: You sold the week after walking with me. Helping with this reply doesn't make that disappear. Leave future messages at the desk; don't speak as my partner.

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: The hour reached us,
precedingBindings.text: The hour reached us,

precedingBindings.speaker: Ives
precedingBindings.quote: Helion likes a complete file. You are the incomplete part.
precedingBindings.text: Helion likes a complete file. You are the incomplete part.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: This is an introduction, not another invoice.
precedingBindings.text: This is an introduction, not another invoice.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You isolated it. The maintenance fault is on their log, even if your name isn't.
precedingBindings.text: You isolated it. The maintenance fault is on their log, even if your name isn't.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: They kept the tool fee, not your promise. You owe no shift for a bargain they refused.
precedingBindings.text: They kept the tool fee, not your promise. You owe no shift for a bargain they refused.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You came back for the shift. The docket stays; the work is done.
precedingBindings.text: You came back for the shift. The docket stays; the work is done.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: You took my introduction and used another way through. A recommendation can go unused. It doesn't become a delivery receipt.
precedingBindings.text: You took my introduction and used another way through. A recommendation can go unused. It doesn't become a delivery receipt.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: The service window closed. Their eyes didn't.
precedingBindings.text: The service window closed. Their eyes didn't.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: The service window ended outside. You found another door; the patrol still noticed.
precedingBindings.text: The service window ended outside. You found another door; the patrol still noticed.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sister Lumen
precedingBindings.quote: You promised to break the hour and sold it instead. This envelope is a different act. Future messages stay at the desk; don't call me your partner.
precedingBindings.text: You promised to break the hour and sold it instead. This envelope is a different act. Future messages stay at the desk; don't call me your partner.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact. Ninety now, two hundred on delivery. Her bodyguard is Kerr. He is paid to stop you.
precedingBindings.text: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: Mara Voss, Helion logistics. Glass Chapel edits her memory at dawn. Bring me the original hour, intact. Ninety now, two hundred on delivery. Her bodyguard is Kerr. He is paid to stop you.
precedingBindings.text: Ninety now, two hundred on delivery. Her bodyguard is Kerr. He is paid to stop you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: This one answer doesn't reopen contact. Leave the pause in place.
precedingBindings.text: This one answer doesn't reopen contact. Leave the pause in place.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: You have no reason to want me behind you.
precedingBindings.text: You have no reason to want me behind you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: You tested this sentence: The later cancellation erases Mara's authorization. What should we do with the verdict you kept?
precedingBindings.text: You tested this sentence: The later cancellation erases Mara's authorization. What should we do with the verdict you kept?

precedingBindings.speaker: Sera
precedingBindings.quote: You tested this sentence: Mara's authorization and the later evacuation cancellation are separate recorded decisions. What should we do with the verdict you kept?
precedingBindings.text: You tested this sentence: Mara's authorization and the later evacuation cancellation are separate recorded decisions. What should we do with the verdict you kept?

precedingBindings.speaker: Nia Pell
precedingBindings.quote: You offered your own shift. Don't turn that into something I owe you.
precedingBindings.text: You offered your own shift. Don't turn that into something I owe you.

precedingBindings.speaker: Kerr
precedingBindings.quote: That stays on my side of the page.
precedingBindings.text: That stays on my side of the page.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: You paid what you had postponed. That settles the forty, not the rest of your night.
precedingBindings.text: You paid what you had postponed. That settles the forty, not the rest of your night.

precedingBindings.speaker: Quill
precedingBindings.quote: My letter wasn't a promise that the gate would forget. That part was yours to keep.
precedingBindings.text: My letter wasn't a promise that the gate would forget. That part was yours to keep.

precedingBindings.quote: Kerr,

additions.speaker: Sister Lumen
additions.quote:
Mara Voss signed the coolant dump into Ward Nine. Three hundred people. One memo. No funeral that used their names. The shard is the only unedited hour.

Sell it to Quill and he sells it to Helion, and Helion buys the last copy of its own crime. Break it, and I leak what I remember. Memory is weaker than a shard. It is still a fire.

additions.speaker: Quill
additions.quote:
Clients call it absolution. The machine reads the hour, files the raw memory, then burns the feeling out and leaves the facts standing there like furniture. The raw file sits in the plinth under the chair.

That file is the product. Saints keep it. Then they sell it back to the same towers that sent them the clients. Mara's hour is worth more to Helion than Mara is.
